contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' (4230.57) on the p4 Summary Page — which is ALSO Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (4230.57) and its printed 'Total Contributions Received / Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report' (4230.57). Three independent printed statements of the same figure.
contributions.detail: The 12 Schedule A rows sum to 712.25 + 55.00 + 237.38 + 275.00 + 402.00 + 475.00 + 28.47 + 148.00 + 1500.00 + 219.34 + 144.68 + 33.45 = 4230.57 exactly — equal to the page's printed subtotal, to the schedule's printed grand total, and to the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell Box B. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' also prints 4230.57 (this is the filer's only report of the cycle, so period == year-to-date) and is NOT summed as an increment. Only 12 of the grid's 15 printed rows are used; rows 13-15 are empty (crop-proved).

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' (4230.57) on the p4 Summary Page — equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (4230.57) and its printed 'Total Expenditures Made' (4230.57)
expenditures.detail: The 12 Schedule B rows as PRINTED sum to 712.25 + 55.00 + 237.38 + 275.00 + 402.00 + 475.00 + 28.47 + 148.00 + 1500.00 + 219.34 + 114.68 + 33.45 = 4200.57, which is 30.00 SHORT of the schedule's own printed subtotal 4230.57 (and of the printed total, and of Box D). The delta is TRACED and UNIQUELY attributable from this page alone: the printed subtotal 4230.57 minus the other eleven rows leaves exactly 144.68 for row 11, whose cell prints 114.68. Row 11's amount cell was escalated to 900 dpi and rendered clean machine type '114.68' — unambiguous, not a legibility question. The row is therefore published 114.68 VERBATIM with needs_review=1 and NOTHING was nudged; no printed total was touched. MISSED-ROW SCREEN FIRST (H3/F1.5): before calling this a filer slip, band 13 (one past the last transcribed row) was cropped and rendered an EMPTY boxed cell, the 15 detected bands run at a perfectly regular 4.45 pitch with no ~2x doubled band, and the white space below the grid carries only the printed Name-of-Candidate box and the Subtotal label — so no row is missing and no band holds two entries. CORROBORATION, not an overwrite: the same transaction on this filing's own Schedule A row 11 prints 144.68 and closes that side exactly, which EXPLAINS the 30.00 as the filer's keying slip; per §C3/§M4 that cross-schedule figure was NOT used to supply the cell's value.

Both conventions were tested and are numerically identical here (there are no in-kind rows to add); monetary-only closes Schedule A exactly at 4230.57.
